about: • Premise: Neptune and 11 Goddesses—including new faces—team up against a world-threatening asteroid and repeated cycles of destruction in Gamindustri. A strange number on Neptune's cheek and a mysterious voice guide her attempt to change fate.
• Aerial & 3D Exploration: Players explore dungeons across both ground and sky, incorporating vertical positioning, aerial combat, and dive attacks.
• Combat & Customization: Features real-time action, customizable combos, team attacks, colossal boss fights, Processor Unit upgrades, Disc Make crafting, and character color/accessory customization.
